API Reference › Biosignal Library

labkit.biosignal.getChannel

Return one signal from a recording by display name or index.

Syntax

function signal = getChannel(recording, channel)

Usage

signal = labkit.biosignal.getChannel(recording, 1);
signal = labkit.biosignal.getChannel(recording, 'ECG');

Inputs

recording
struct returned by readRecording.
channel
1-based numeric index, channel name, or display name.

Output

signal
one signal struct with time, values, fs, name, displayName, and metadata.
